content.text:
`out()`函数输出给定范围内的数字。我们使用一个**time.Sleep()**来模拟输出之间的工作，只是为了演示。它仅在继续执行之前等待**50ms**时间。

现在，如果我们在`main()`函数中调用了两次`out()`函数：第一次调用将首先执行，然后是第二次调用。

这将输出0到5的，然后是6到10。
content.text_html:
The out() function simply outputs numbers in the given range. We use a time.Sleep() to emulate work being done between the outputs just for demonstration purposes. It simply waits for the provided time (50ms) before continuing the execution.

Now, if we call the function in main two times, the first call will execute first followed by the second call. This will generate the output of 0 to 5, then 6 to 10.

out()函数只是输出给定范围内的数字。我们使用一个time.Sleep()来模拟输出之间的工作，只是为了演示。它只是在继续执行之前等待所提供的时间（50ms）。

现在，如果我们两次调用main中的函数，第一次调用将首先执行，然后是第二次调用。 这将产生0到5的输出，然后是6到10。

content.text: 上面为顺序执行程序，因为这些语句是一个接一个地执行的。第一个调用需要完成，然后才开始第二个调用。
content.text_html:
This is called a sequential program, as the statements are executed one after the other. The first call needs to complete, before the second call starts.

这被称为顺序程序，因为这些语句是一个接一个地执行的。第一个调用需要完成，然后才开始第二个调用。

resolved.title: 协程 Goroutine
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Goroutines[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

When running concurrent programs, do not often want to wait for one task to finish before starting a new one.
To achieve concurrency, let's start the function calls as Goroutines, using the [b]go[/b] keyword:[code format="go" codeId="3360"]func main() {
  go out(0, 5)
  go out(6, 10)
} [/code]
As you can see, it is very simple to start a Goroutine -- we simply need to add a [b]go[/b] keyword before the function call.

If we run the program, we get a surprising output -- it will result in [b]No Output[/b].
But why? This output happens because the [b]main()[/b] function exits before the Goroutines complete.
[note]Our program has 3 virtual threads: the 2 function calls, and main(). Our 2 function calls get executed concurrently, and main() does not wait for them to finish.[/note]

resolved.title: 协程 Goroutine
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Goroutines[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

There is a mechanism to sync the Goroutines so that we know when one completes its execution in [b]main[/b]().
Before learning about that mechanism, let's add a [b]time.Sleep()[/b] to the end of the [b]main[/b]() function in order to see the Goroutines in action:[code format="go" codeId="3361"]go out(0, 5)
go out(6, 10)

time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond) [/code]
The 500ms wait should be enough time for the Goroutines to finish executing and generating the output.
[note]Now when you run the code, you will see that the output is not sequential, each Goroutine worked independent and concurrently.[/note]

在了解这个机制之前，让我们在**main**()函数的末尾添加一个**time.Sleep()**，以便看到Goroutine在运行。

There is a mechanism to sync the Goroutines so that we know when one completes its execution in main(). Before learning about that mechanism, let's add a time.Sleep() to the end of the main() function in order to see the Goroutines in action:

 go out(6, 10)

content.text: 500ms的等待时间应该足够让Goroutine完成执行并产生输出。

The 500ms wait should be enough time for the Goroutines to finish executing and generating the output.

500ms的等待时间应该足够让Goroutines完成执行并产生输出。

content.text: 现在，当你运行代码时，你会看到输出不是连续的，每个Goroutine都是独立、并发的工作。

Now when you run the code, you will see that the output is not sequential, each Goroutine worked independent and concurrently.
